_comment: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fossil_Island (ändrad 10 okt 2026) - ön nås efter Bone Voyage.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bone_Voyage (ändrad 22 nov 2026) - 100 Kudos och The Dig Site. Kudos syns inte för
pluginet, så det är ett manuellt mål.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Museum_Camp (ändrad 28 sep 2026) - fossil cleaning station Construction 5, bank chest 21
(2 oak planks, 1 iron bar, 5 nails), well 22, cooking pot 24, spinning wheel 28, loom 29; hammer från butiken på ön.
hittas och användas en gång: House on the Hill, Verdant Valley, Sticky Swamp (yxa och kratta), Mushroom Meadow.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Volcanic_Mine (ändrad 3 nov 2026) - Mining 50; 30 numulite per besök eller 3 000
numulite för permanent tillträde. Osäkert: 3 000 kommer från en sammanfattning av sidans senare del. Numulite = item
House on the Hill: en digsite pendant laddas vid Strange Machine för en teleport dit; kostnaden står inte på sidan.
Inte med (inte kontrollerat): fågelholkar, Fossil Island-wyverns slayerkrav, undervattensområdet.
name: Fossil Island
description: Bone Voyage, the Museum Camp, the Magic Mushtrees and the Volcanic Mine

children.title: 100 Kudos at the Varrock Museum
children.note: Kudos come from the museum quiz, cleaning finds and some quests.

children.title: Museum Camp bank chest
children.note: Build it with 2 oak planks, 1 iron bar and 5 nails and a hammer from the island's shop.

children.title: Every Museum Camp building
children.note: Cleaning station (5), bank chest (21), well (22), cooking pot (24), spinning wheel (28) and loom (29). In all: 10 oak planks, 5 planks, 2 iron bars, 25 nails, 2 ropes, 2 logs, 3 soft clay, a bucket and a tinderbox.

children.title: Find all four Magic Mushtrees
children.note: House on the Hill, Verdant Valley, Sticky Swamp (needs an axe and a rake) and Mushroom Meadow. Each must be used once.

children.title: Digsite pendant teleport to the House on the Hill
children.note: Use a digsite pendant on the southernmost Strange Machine in the house.

children.title: Volcanic Mine
children.note: Entry costs 30 numulite per visit, or 3,000 numulite once for permanent access.
For permanent Volcanic Mine access. Numulite comes from fossil island activities such as the Volcanic Mine and cleaning.
